senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; יָקַד)fire-place, hearth where fire is maintained.—בית המ׳ the room (in the Temple) in which fire is perpetually maintained.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:1">Tam. I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:1">Midd. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:11">Sabb. I, 11</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 19b:6">19ᵇ</cite>) <he>מדורת בית מ׳</he> the pile in the fire-room (in the Temple or in private houses).
